questions.q: What does the `.lab()` method do in Mr Markdown?
options: Renders a standard markdown code block
Mounts an interactive sandboxed JavaScript simulation
questions.explanation: The `.lab()` method is specifically designed to mount sandboxed JS simulations for interactive learning labs.
